title: Helluva Boss
description: An adult animated comedy series created by Vivienne Medrano. It follows the Immediate Murder Professionals (I.M.P.), a small crew of imps who run an assassination business in Hell.

episodes.title: Murder Family
episodes.overview: A schoolteacher who died in a violent betrayal hires I.M.P. to finish off her husband's mistress. The job leads the crew into the home of a family of devil-worshipping cannibals.

episodes.title: Loo Loo Land
episodes.overview: Stolas hires I.M.P. to guard him and his daughter Octavia on a tense family day at an amusement park, where Blitzo also runs into an old, hostile coworker.

episodes.title: Spring Broken
episodes.overview: A fight over the company parking space with Blitzo's ex, the pop star Verosika Mayday, turns into a contest on Earth that goes wrong when a mutated fish attacks.

episodes.title: C.H.E.R.U.B
episodes.overview: An inventor newly arrived in Hell wants his old business partner dead, but a trio of cherubs from Heaven turns up to convince the target his life is worth living.

episodes.title: The Harvest Moon Festival
episodes.overview: I.M.P. visits Millie's family in the Wrath ring during a harvest festival, where a charming farmhand turns out to be an assassin targeting Stolas.

episodes.title: Truth Seekers
episodes.overview: Blitzo and Moxxie are captured by a secret agency on Earth and dosed with truth serum while the rest of the crew mounts a rescue.

episodes.title: Ozzie's
episodes.overview: Moxxie and Millie celebrate their anniversary at an exclusive restaurant in the Lust ring, and Blitzo schemes his way in by asking Stolas on a date.

episodes.title: Queen Bee
episodes.overview: Loona is invited to a hellhound party in the Gluttony ring, while Blitzo is still dealing with what happened at Ozzie's.

episodes.title: The Circus
episodes.overview: Flashbacks show how Stolas and Blitzo first met, then the story returns to the aftermath of their disastrous date.

episodes.title: Seeing Stars
episodes.overview: When Stolas forgets a promise to watch a meteor shower, Octavia runs off to Los Angeles with his grimoire and I.M.P. goes after her.

episodes.title: Exes and Oohs
episodes.overview: I.M.P. visits Moxxie's mafia-boss father, who tries to arrange Moxxie's marriage to a shark demon with a shady agenda.

episodes.title: Western Energy
episodes.overview: Striker kidnaps Stolas on Stella's orders, and I.M.P. steps in before a change of plan spares his life.

episodes.title: Unhappy Campers
episodes.overview: Moxxie leads a mission for the first time and it goes badly, while Blitzo tries to make peace with his estranged sister.

episodes.title: Oops
episodes.overview: Blitzo and Fizzarolli are held for ransom and have to cooperate to escape, mending an old friendship along the way.

episodes.title: Mammon's Magnificent Musical Mid-Season Special (ft Fizzarolli)
episodes.overview: Fizzarolli enters a clown pageant run by Mammon, with Blitzo hired as his bodyguard, and a secret relationship comes into the open.

episodes.title: The Full Moon
episodes.overview: Blitzo gets ready for his monthly night with Stolas while rival groups from Heaven and the human world hunt him.

episodes.title: Apology Tour
episodes.overview: After another fight with Stolas, Blitzo tries apologising to people he has wronged, ending at a party that forces him to face his behaviour.

episodes.title: Ghostf**ckers
episodes.overview: Reeling from his breakup, Blitzo drags I.M.P. to a haunted hotel for a job and ends up tormented by his own guilt.

episodes.title: Mastermind
episodes.overview: I.M.P. is arrested and put on trial in Hell, and Stolas makes a costly choice to save Blitzo.

episodes.title: Sinsmas
episodes.overview: I.M.P. celebrates Hell's version of Christmas while Stolas tries to reconnect with Octavia, and the team's holiday job doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Turtle Emoji
episodes.overview: Stolas sends Blitzo a turtle emoji, setting off unexpected developments in their relationship.

episodes.title: Bad Reputation
episodes.overview: Millie takes centre stage as questions about her reputation and her future come up.

episodes.title: Gimpy Gimpy
episodes.overview: The crew travels to Australia for another unpredictable adventure.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: The original pilot introduces I.M.P. and a job that splits the team. The creator has said it is not part of the main story.

episodes.title: Mission: Zero
episodes.overview: A reimagining of the pilot, in which Blitzo expands the business to target living humans and borrows Stolas's grimoire to get to Earth.

episodes.title: Hell's Belles
episodes.overview: Millie spends a day in Imp City with her sister Sallie May, and the two talk about how their jobs have shaped them.

episodes.title: Mission: Antarctica
episodes.overview: A simple job in Antarctica turns into an escape from a flock of flesh-eating penguins.

episodes.title: Mission: Weeaboo-Boo
episodes.overview: Blitzo kills a young woman who is fond of demons, only to have her turn up in Hell and vow to stay by his side.

episodes.title: Mission: Chupacabras
episodes.overview: Blitzo is captured by a goat farmer who takes him for a Chupacabra and has to improvise a way out as agents close in.

episodes.title: Mission: Orphan Time
episodes.overview: Blitzo and Loona are sent to kill a children's entertainer but let him say goodbye to his kids first.

episodes.title: Mission: Bad Drivezo
episodes.overview: After a job, Blitzo gets so angry at a reckless driver that he chases him down.

episodes.title: Mission: Whacked Off
episodes.overview: While Blitzo and Millie go fishing, Moxxie is sent to kill a mobster's son and ends up sympathising with his target.

episodes.title: Mission: Big Boss
episodes.overview: Annoyed by his team's pushback, Blitzo kills a CEO and takes over his identity to enjoy a secretary who agrees with everything.

episodes.title: Mission: Bigfoot
episodes.overview: I.M.P. is hired to hunt Bigfoot without realising he is helping them.

episodes.title: Mission: It's Chaz Funeral
episodes.overview: Blitzo, Moxxie and Millie are invited to Chaz's "funeral".

episodes.title: Barbie's Bad Day
episodes.overview: Barbie loses her job after the events of "Unhappy Campers" and struggles to get home to her girlfriend.

episodes.title: IMP Training Video
episodes.overview: Blitzo tries to film a staff training video, but nobody sticks to his terrible script.

episodes.title: Mission: Book Report
episodes.overview: Moxxie helps Stolas turn Blitzo's awful drawings of a mission into a proper report.

episodes.title: The Princess & the Pupper
episodes.overview: Loona helps Octavia sneak back home after Octavia slips out to see her favourite band. (Official warning: for daddy issues.)
